$comment: Contract test vectors for the AwcmsHostBridge native module (packages/platform/src/contract.ts, hostBridgeVersion 1).
Replay every case against HostBridgeDispatcher (Kotlin / Swift / ArkTS) with an in-memory SecureStore and a recording LinkOpener,
then replay the storage cases against the real KeystoreSecureStore / KeychainSecureStore / HuksSecureStore on a device.
Cases are independent: run them in order, each with a fresh dispatcher OR make sure the storage cleanup steps ran.
Generated by a script from the contract; edit the contract and regenerate rather than hand-editing the cases.

semantics.reply: The module answers with ONE JSON string (the callback argument). Parse it, then compare with `expect`.
semantics.expect: Subset match: every property in `expect` must be present and deep-equal in the reply object. Arrays and scalars compare exactly. `error.message` is never compared.

generators.$repeat: {prefix, text, count} expands to prefix + text repeated count times. Length limits are in UTF-16 code units (JS String.length); 'text' may contain astral characters.

semantics.linkOpener: When a case has `linkOpener`, install a recording opener whose open() returns `returns`. After the case, the recorded URL list must equal `expectOpenedUrls` (same URLs, same order; platforms that hand the opener a parsed URL type may normalise scheme/host case, so compare those case-insensitively). Cases without `linkOpener` never reach the opener.
semantics.request: `request.method` and `request.params` are passed to the module exactly as the JS bridge would pass them; a missing `params` property means 'argument absent' (null/undefined natively).

notCovered: STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: needs a failing store (inject one that throws) — assert {ok:false,error:{code:'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE'}} for get/set/delete.
HOST_ERROR: needs a dispatcher internals fault; assert that the module still answers with a JSON string and never throws.
The JS hosts (apps/web via packages/platform/src/web-host.ts, apps/desktop/src/main/host.ts) apply the same rules through checkHostParams and replay these vectors in tests/contract-vectors.test.ts.
